name: dev-workflow
title: Development workflows
summary: Phased orchestration skills for feature work, bugfixes, behaviour-preserving refactors and read-only codebase analysis — with journals under AI_DIR (feature constitutions, bugfix and refactor records, follow-ups, DoD checklists, regression suites, diagrams), rubber-duk review gates and published explainers.

plugins.why: Each workflow phase runs a superpowers skill (brainstorming, writing-plans, subagent-driven-development, systematic-debugging, TDD, code review, finishing a branch).
Research and unknowns phases use research-planning:iterative-research and research-planning:mapping-unknowns.

vendorSkills.why: Reproduce and smoke-test in the running app.
